soru: Where did Mina find the umbrella?
kanit: It was standing alone at the bus stop, bright red, like a flower in the grey rain.

soru: Why didn't Mina take the umbrella on the first day?
tr: Mina ilk gün şemsiyeyi neden almadı?
secenekler: She did not want to steal it
kanit: She did not want to steal it, so she left it there and got on the bus.

soru: What name did someone give the umbrella?
kanit: Someone gave it a name: Ruby.

soru: Who wrote the note with the careful letters?
tr: Özenli harflerle yazılmış notu kim yazdı?
secenekler: The old woman next to Mina
kanit: "I am the first note," he said. "The careful letters."

soru: Why did they laugh at the end?
secenekler: The sun came out, so nobody needed an umbrella
kanit: When they finished, the sun came out, and they both laughed, because now nobody needed an umbrella at all.
